title: Exceptional composition and proper-square exchange under a cohomological comparison
statement:
Fix two correspondences $c,\bar c$ of separated finite-type $k$-schemes with finite coefficients $A=A_{E,n}$, and a compactifiable cohomological pre-comparison $(f_Z,t_Z,\alpha_g,\beta_g,\iota)$ of [def-trf-cohomological-comparison]. Use its dualizing comparisons $\delta_Z$, ordinary mates $\alpha_{g,*}$ and exceptional mates $\beta_{g,!}$, with the constructible adjunctions of [def-trf-admissibility]. The following identities hold on their finite-Tor constructible domains.

(a) Exceptional composition: $\beta_{\operatorname{id}}=\operatorname{id}$ and $\beta_{hg}=\bar g^!(\beta_h)\circ\beta_g(h^!(-))$, under the exceptional composition identifications.

(b) Dualizing composition: for every diagram arrow $g:U\to V$,
$$\delta_U=\bar g^!(\delta_V)\circ\beta_g(\omega_V)$$
under $g^!\omega_V=\omega_U$ and $\bar g^!\omega_{\bar V}=\omega_{\bar U}$ of [thm-trf-dualizing-complex-composition].

(c) Let $h:U\to W$, $v:V\to W$, $U'=V\times_WU$, $h':U'\to V$, $v':U'\to U$ form a Cartesian square of arrows in the unbarred fixed diagram, and assume the corresponding barred square is Cartesian. Suppose $h,h',\bar h,\bar h'$ are proper. Let $E:Rh'_*v'^!\xrightarrow{\sim}v^!Rh_*$ and $\bar E:R\bar h'_*\bar v'^!\xrightarrow{\sim}\bar v^!R\bar h_*$ be the right-adjoint fixed-square exchange maps, normalized as mates of compact-support exchange. Then for every $M\in D^b_{ctf}(U,A)$,
$$\bar v^!(\alpha_{h,*})\circ\beta_v(Rh_*M)\circ f_V(E_M)=\bar E_{f_UM}\circ R\bar h'_*(\beta_{v'}(M))\circ\alpha_{h',*}(v'^!M)$$
as maps $f_VRh'_*v'^!M\to\bar v^!R\bar h_*f_UM$.

source.place: Lemma 4.2.1(a),(b),(c2), using proper direct-image identifications as in §4.4.6
